- Amar led a 5-person runtime team at Nimbus AI that reduced p99 generation latency by 35% across multi-model workloads via KV prefetch and custom CUDA kernels.
- He authored the sharding strategy we plan to use for cross-region cache consistency — directly applicable to our Dedicated product timeline.
- Expected to be an IC4/IC5-equivalent — will own runtime performance projects that unblock Dedicated throughput SLAs.

Proposed comp structure:
- Base: $210,000
- Target cash bonus: 20%
- Equity: RSU refresh + 4-year vesting (tbd) — recommend $60k annualized value target to hit $310k TC.
- Sign-on (to offset loss of unvested equity at Nimbus): $40k one-time cash (prorated if notice period >30 days).

Business risk of NOT hiring at that level:
- Projected 4–6 month delay on key latency work; increased infra costs while we iterate on team skills.

Budget ask: I request a band exception to approve up to $310k TC (one-off for this hire).

Attachments: I uploaded Amar's loop notes and a short tech write-up to the hiring folder (drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AExample).
